title: I turn 2D creature concepts into game-ready 3D models with an AI pipeline - here are my 20 best (free sample)
author: didacsandra
selftext:
Hi! Solo dev here. My pipeline: AI concept image (3 views) -> TRELLIS 2 image-to-3D -> automatic cleanup in Blender (under 15k tris) -> I review the results and keep only the good ones.



This is the Top 20 pack: stylized creatures (bat dragon, jellyfish, goblin, wolves, spider, armored beasts...), GLB + FBX, ready for Unity, Unreal and Godot.



\- Free sample on the page, so you can check the quality before buying

\- $4.90, and 30% off from Nov 27 to Dec 2

\- Honest note: it's AI-assisted, not hand-sculpted. Some results are better than others, that's why I only kept 20.



[https://didacsandra.itch.io/top-20-stylized-creatures](https://didacsandra.itch.io/top-20-stylized-creatures)



Feedback welcome, especially on topology and textures!
